items.sentence: Mars is a rocky planet orbiting between Earth and giant Jupiter.
Students conduct a fair science test by changing only one variable.
Ice is the solid form of water at low cold temperatures.
The stone pyramid seemed to stand in eternal stillness under stars.
Earth's gravity pulls the dropped apple downward toward the grassy lawn.
Solid ice cubes melt quickly when placed in warm drinking water.
The brave astronaut floated weightlessly outside the orbiting space station lab.
Wooden blocks slide easily across the smooth surface of the ramp.
Green plants release fresh oxygen into the air during sunny daylight.
Four sturdy wooden legs support the heavy science laboratory work table.
